purpose: Render rigged 3D characters into atlases for the existing Godot 2D actor runtime
firstTrial: One Legend with textures, humanoid rig, idle and walk; verify round-trip before all races
preferredExports: GLB with embedded textures and animation tracks
FBX plus textures and animation files
poseForRigging: A-pose or T-pose with separated limbs; do not mistake an existing idle sprite for a rigging pose
camera: Orthographic, fixed framing and lighting for the whole clip; verify actual model-forward axis visually before assigning directions
rootMotion: In-place; world displacement remains controlled by existing gameplay
sourceAngleWarning: Some existing named diagonal sprites are frontal; names alone are not reliable multi-view references
rigReview: Hands, robe and armor do not clip in motion
Fixed feet/scale and no camera auto-reframing per pose
acceptance: Correct directions and temporal consistency must be shown in the actual engine. Contract export is not a tested Meshy importer or commercial-license clearance.
